definitions.short: shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off)
definitions.full: H7095. qetseb קֶ֫צֶב noun masculine 1Kin 6:25 1 cut, shape ; 2 extremity ; — 1 ׳ק absolute, shape of cherubim 1Kin 6:25 ( + מִדָּה ), of bases 7:37 (+ id. ). 2 extremity , plural construct הָרִים קִצְבֵי Jonah 2:7 the extremities (bottoms) of (the) mountains ( = הרים קצבי Ecclus 16:19).
